title: Anthropic previews Claude Duet, a proactive agent that works across apps
summary: Claude Duet, powered by Opus 5.5, monitors connected apps, prioritises tasks and works on its own, asking approval before certain actions. It is a research preview for US Pro/Max users via a waitlist.
reason: Moves consumer agents toward acting unprompted; it is a waitlisted preview with approval gates, so T1.

title: OpenAI and PHP maintainers patch critical flaws found by an OpenAI model
summary: OpenAI worked with PHP maintainers and security partners to patch critical vulnerabilities its GPT Sol model found (Wiz found them separately). It released a checker and proposed a framework for disclosing AI-discovered flaws.
reason: AI vulnerability discovery used for coordinated defence of widely used software; self-reported, so T1.

title: Malicious LiteLLM v1.107.0 published to PyPI, live for about 2 hours
summary: LiteLLM said its v1.107.0 release on PyPI was compromised on Oct 21 and removed after about 2 hours.
reason: A confirmed supply-chain attack on a widely used AI library; short-lived with no known impact, so T1.

title: Goldman Sachs: AI could displace up to 9% of US workers during the transition
summary: Goldman economist Joseph Briggs estimates up to 9% of workers could be displaced if AI lifts productivity by 15%, plus about 3% from slower hiring. Only 23% of US establishments have built AI into workflows.
reason: A prominent bank forecast of job displacement; a projection, not an event, so T1 signal.
